# P0-01 — Merge the agent branch into main

Branch `build/w0-consolidate` from `origin/main` (`cca2101`); `git merge --no-ff origin/claude/ucgle-f1-agent-simulator-agRxR`
(`bcc751e`). 50 conflicted paths — every one resolved in `docs/build/MERGE-MAP.md`.

## Presence check (both sides)

- Backend: `backend/src/ucgle_f1/{m1..m8,adapters}`, `backend/src/cosmic_forge_viz`, `backend/audit/{physics,agent}`
  (S1–S15, A1–A9), `backend/audit/golden.lock` — present.
- Packages: qcompass-core, qcompass-router, qcompass-bench, qfull-{chemistry,condmat,hep,nuclear,amo,gravity,statmech},
  qcompass meta-package, ts/qcompass-frontend-sdk — present. Main's 6A router tests preserved in
  `packages/qcompass-router/tests/lineage_6a/`.
- Frontend: main's routes (`domains/$domain/*`, admin.verdict, pricing, status, qa, login, reset-password,
  auth.callback, visualizer) + branch panels (`src/components/visualizer/panels/**`, 19 panels) + energy-comparison
  card (now in `src/components/results/chemistry/ChemistryResult.tsx`) — present.
- Fixtures: main's `public/fixtures/**` + branch-only files (per-domain visualization timelines, chemistry
  `manifest-schema.json` main version, etc.) — present.
- Docs/workflows/acceptance from the branch — present (`docs/qcompass/`, `mkdocs.yml`, `acceptance/`,
  `.github/workflows/{ucglef1-drift-alarm,phase3-verdict,release-please}.yml`, branch CI kept as `ci-python.yml`).

## Python suites run

Command (venv with backend + all 11 packages installed; same overrides as BASELINE.md):
`cd backend && pytest -q -o asyncio_default_fixture_loop_scope=function -W 'ignore:Using `httpx` with `starlette.testclient`'`
→ **21 failed, 129 passed, 1 xfailed** (16 min).
`pytest packages -q --import-mode=importlib -o asyncio_default_fixture_loop_scope=function ...`
→ **11 failed, 283 passed, 7 skipped** (5 min).

Failure ownership (none introduced outside these):
- `test_gb_to_zero_decoupling`, `test_python_mirrors_every_ts_type`, six `test_qcompass_adapter.py` tests — present in
  the baselines; owned by P0-04 (Gate 0 requires every suite green).
- 13 `tests/test_lovable_contract.py` failures — that test asserted the branch's chemistry/HEP/gravity/verdict fixture
  shapes; P0-01's rule makes main's fixtures win. Owned by P0-04 (test correction with ledger entry) and P4-01
  (`test_frontend_contract.py`).
- 9 `lineage_6a/*` + 2 `test_pricing_stub.py` failures — main's 6A router tests run against the agent-lineage router;
  owned by P0-02 ("the union of both router histories passes every router test").

`npx tsc --noEmit` → 1 error, the pre-existing `src/routes/pricing.tsx(70,20)` (owned by P0-03).
